name: Hosts Landing Zone
description: An account's footprint in one region hosts a Control Tower landing zone (footprint -> landing zone): the landing zone controltower:ListLandingZones returned whose ARN names this region, its home region. A landing zone is emitted once by ARN, whichever regional endpoint returned it. Containment, parent -> child: the footprint declares this edge in CONTAINMENT_EDGES, so a landing zone the grid holds under a footprint whose account_region.landing_zones listing a run read to the end and did not name becomes a retirement candidate, which this type's falsifier then probes. Collected by the landing-zone reader (collectors/boto3_collector/landing_zone.py), which records that footprint's completeness surface under the same per-region rules as a manifest entry. One edge type per listed type: see tap_plugin.aws_core.regional.
